shorts_rules: State the core conflict, mystery, or shocking scale immediately in the first sentence without filler or slow setup.
Make any technical numbers or scales feelable by comparing them instantly to familiar objects or everyday distances.
Keep narration pacing brisk between 2.8 and 3.5 words per second to maintain high viewer retention.
Break down complex engineering or scientific concepts into simple, chronological step-by-step problem-solving beats.
Avoid technical jargon or dry engineering specs in early sentences, substituting them with tangible physical stakes.
Never use recycled catchphrases or generic channel sign-offs; write a fresh, specific question or observation mentioning Tomorrowly every time.
Transition from the hook to the clear topic within the first 3 to 7 seconds to prevent early viewer drop-off.
visual_sound_notes: Use large, uppercase, multi-colored captions with 2 to 4 words per frame and highlight key words in red or yellow.
Maintain an average of 2.5 to 3.5 cuts per 10 seconds to keep visual momentum synchronized with the voice-over narration.
Pair high-impact moments, impacts, and transitions with distinct mechanical or cinematic sound effects.
Layer tense or upbeat cinematic documentary background music cleanly underneath upfront, crisp voice-over tracks.
summary_roman_urdu: Is mahine viral hone wali shorts mein visual shock, immediate conflict, aur scale ki zabardast kashish dekhi gayi hai jo shuru ke kuch seconds mein viewer ko baandh leti hai. Humari pichhli videos mein drop-off aksar shuruati lines ya dry technical specs (jaise hydraulic lines ya batteries) ki wajah se huya, jisse log jaldi chhod gaye. Hamein titles aur topics ko zyada kashish-daar (attractive) banana hoga taake CTR behtar ho. Aakhri sign-off mein generic sentences ki jagah hamesha ek naya, fresh sawal ya observation rakhna zaroori hai taake comments barh sakein.
